groups.owner: host identity and UI runtime binding
groups.decision: Extend identity with backend family; preserve OpenCode generation behind its adapter. Bind operations and cached results to backend, connection epoch and capability revision.
Retain raw SDK access for OpenCode only. Refuse for CAgent and migrate a consumer to a neutral operation before enabling its feature.
Retain host-local semantics and authorization. Never infer access from a CAgent workspace ID or path.

groups.owner: filesystem runtime plus backend workspace binding
groups.decision: Split local mkdir from createDirectory(asProject), which calls /opencode/directory. Gate project creation and setOpenCodeWorkingDirectory through selected backend binding; no OpenCode restart for CAgent.
Map verified conversation IDs and workspace ownership; normalize metadata with provenance. OpenChamber archive metadata is separately scoped by backend identity. Never fabricate OpenCode wire fields.
Normalize messages, pagination and completion without SDK raw payloads. Disable history/reopen when unavailable; failure is distinct from an empty page.
Preserve prompt, command and selection semantics separately. Track durable intent and unknown outcomes before effects; no implicit resend across backend changes.

groups.owner: backend activity observation and OpenChamber aggregation
groups.decision: Translate live status and descendant activity through neutral contracts. Host aggregation needs proven backend observation; persisted history cannot establish liveness.
Require verified cancellation semantics, including unknown outcome. Disable cancellation-dependent unattended modes if absent.
Gate each method independently. Import and synthetic messages need real server persistence semantics; fork, share, move and revert cannot be approximated by relabeling or local-only changes.
Separate backend workspace discovery and file search from host-local filesystem/Git. Gate projects, VCS, LSP, tool IDs, commands and skills independently.
Keep permission, question and form semantics distinct. A chat mode capable of demanding an unanswerable decision remains disabled.

groups.owner: backend configuration adapter and host cache
groups.decision: Keep cache invalidation host-owned. Gate every server read/write and provider catalog operation. Existing OpenCode settings writers remain OpenCode-only; CAgent never inherits their paths or config format.
Use verified backend catalog, connection and resource semantics. Disable raw SDK OAuth/reconnect actions until explicit operations exist.

groups.owner: backend credential operations with existing secret owner
groups.decision: Gate each credential and integration operation. Never substitute OpenCode provider OAuth for CAgent authentication; exported fixtures contain no secrets.

acceptance.CA-01: Typed contracts and guards, including direct and browser-closed callers, with OC1/OC2 regressions. No real CAgent support claim.
acceptance.CA-02: Protected offline kit validates per-operation semantics, feature rules and denied edits against sparse and extension samples.
acceptance.CA-03: Actual API evidence and live accepted adapter revision determine support and host availability. Unexamined operations stay unverified.
